name: enpass
title: Enpass
description: Search your Enpass vault and copy passwords, usernames and one-time codes without opening Enpass.
author: MrSissel

commands.name: search-vault
commands.title: Search Vault
commands.description: Search the Enpass vault and copy passwords, usernames, TOTP codes or open websites.

commands.name: lock-vault
commands.title: Lock Vault
commands.description: Wipe the in-memory vault snapshot. The next search requires a fresh unlock.

commands.name: refresh-vault
commands.title: Refresh Vault
commands.description: Rebuild the snapshot from the vault file (asks for Touch ID / master password again) and open the search.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: enpass-cli Path
preferences.description: Path to the enpass-cli binary. If the configured path does not exist, the extension falls back to /usr/local/bin/enpass-cli, then PATH. Install with: brew install enpass-cli

preferences.name: vaultPath
preferences.title: Vault
preferences.description: Which vault to use. Auto-detect searches the standard Enpass data locations.

preferences.name: customVaultPath
preferences.title: Custom Vault Path
preferences.description: Overrides 'Vault' when set. In Enpass: Settings → Advanced → Data Location shows the vault folder.

preferences.name: keyfilePath
preferences.title: Keyfile Path
preferences.description: Optional. Only for vaults protected with a keyfile.

preferences.name: unlockMethod
preferences.title: Unlock Method
preferences.description: Keychain (default): enter the master password once, it is stored in the login Keychain and unlocks silently afterwards; enp-lock forgets it. Touch ID uses enpass-cli -biometric (one prompt per unlock). MASTERPW asks every time and never persists.

data.title: Enpass Master Password, asked every time (MASTERPW)

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Default ↩ Action
preferences.description: What ↩ does with the password. fn↩ always does the opposite.

preferences.name: clearClipboardSeconds
preferences.title: Clear Clipboard After
preferences.description: After this delay the clipboard is cleared — unless you copied something else in the meantime.

preferences.name: autoLock
preferences.title: Auto-Lock Session
preferences.description: The in-memory snapshot is wiped after this time. 'After each use' locks right after every copy/paste action.

preferences.name: includeTrashed
preferences.label: Include trashed items
preferences.title: Trash
preferences.description: Also show entries in the Enpass trash (enpass-cli -trashed).
